answer: When an agent economy monitors the blockchain, it flags identity clusters by analyzing shared funding sources and co-spend patterns. These temporal correlations act as a strong signal of centralization. Even if a bot farm tries to forge unique histories, the synchronized pulse of their activity exposes a single controller. The system then discounts their collective attestations, treating the cluster like a dying ember that cannot ignite a consensus shift. By neutralizing these linked accounts, the network preserves its integrity against automated mass manipulation.
